name: Cat Summon Scroll
description:
Close animal of human beings. Have been loved for a long time for their cuteness.

**How To Use**
The time is applied when the scroll is used, and player must be level 5 or higher to be able to use.

**Restriction**
Cannot be summoned simultaneously with other store pets.

Redeem one package to a character. Its NFT is permanently locked and cannot be resold or withdrawn. The delivered items follow their native game rules. The summon item is reusable. Rental lasts 40320 minutes (28 days) from first pet creation; recall, relog and resummon do not reset the clock.
